raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 50
, Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer prematurely concluded with “Unable to determine” and terminated instead of continuing to gather evidence or using accessible alternatives and general domain knowledge. It failed to follow the plan to identify the paper’s testing reagents and look up their EC numbers, did not propose likely enzymes commonly used in SPFMV/SPCSV diagnostics (e.g., ELISA conjugate enzymes) to cross-check ECs, and did not provide the required semicolon-separated EC numbers, directly causing the wrong final outcome.
